+13 "Revelation first" can refer to several different contexts depending on whether you are studying the Bible, theology, or even popular culture.Here is a breakdown of the concept based on the three most common applications:1. In Biblical Studies (The Book of Revelation)In the context of the New Testament, "revelation" refers to the Apocalypse of John.The First Vision: Chapter 1 centers on the glory of the resurrected Jesus Christ. Instead of portraying Jesus as a humble Galilean, it presents Him as the Alpha and Omega, the "First and Last," commanding John to write to the seven churches in Asia.The "Revelation First" Argument: A minority academic and theological argument—popularized in modern theological discussions—posits that the Book of Revelation was actually the first New Testament document written, well before the Gospels or Paul's letters.2. In Christian Theology (General vs. Special Revelation)In theology, "revelation" (from the Greek apokalypsis) is the foundational concept that God reveals Himself to humanity.General Revelation: God reveals Himself through nature, the cosmos, and human conscience—making Himself known to all of mankind from the "first" day.Special Revelation: God reveals Himself through specific events, prophets, or the person of Jesus Christ.3. In Literature and GamingIn storytelling (such as the Destiny video game franchise), "Revelation" is the name of an expansion or lore arc. In this context, "revelation first" refers to prioritizing the lore drops and world-building mysteries of the universe before the combat or action gameplay begins.Could you clarify which type of "revelation first" you are looking for?Are you doing a biblical study on Revelation Chapter 1?Are you interested in the theological definition of divine revelation?Are you looking into a gaming/fictional lore context?Let me know what you're tracking so we can dive into the specifics!Revelation First Century Context- "Apocalypse" Series? : r/BibleProjectMay 11, 2025 — I believe John was well into his late 80's or early 90's when he wrote it.
